caption: The drawing depicts a bracelet composed of a series of vertically aligned, elongated hexagonal segments connected by small circular golden links. Each hexagonal segment is framed with a gold-colored border and filled with a mix of white and black with patches of yellow, possibly indicating a decorative pattern or inlaid stones. The left side of the bracelet includes a flat rectangular clasp, while the right end features a triangular piece with similar decoration, capped with a round gold sphere. Above the segments, a thin gold chain connects the ends of the bracelet. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the gold, white, black, and yellow elements that make up the bracelet’s design.
title: Bracelet
